The HWPX generation failed because the required 'High (즉시조치)' severity string was missing from the combined XML sections of the output document.
Execution failed in test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present within /tests/test_outputs.py. The assertion `assert f'{value} ({severity_map[value]})' in combined` failed because 'High (즉시조치)' was not found in the generated section0.xml or section1.xml. While 3 tests passed, the verifier returned a reward of 0.00 due to this missing metadata in the HWPX XML structure.
